```text
# #2106: Patch: player-facing text in one voice, with no developer jargon
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

### What it does

Some of the client's text reads the way a developer thinks about a screen rather than how a player reads it, for example "No card is 3 standard errors from 50% yet." and "Your decks: 1 of 3 decks have won". Write a short voice guide for player-facing text (warm, plain, short, consistent casing and punctuation, no developer jargon) and bring the client's text in line with it, translations included.

### Acceptance

- The client has a short voice guide.
- Player-facing text follows it, and the worst offenders are rewritten.

### Blocked by, part of

_No response_
```
